summary: The candidate fixes the original single-label /v1/score response-shape defect at the production tokenizer-manager boundary. Scalar scheduler outputs become one-element rows, existing row-shaped and multi-label outputs are preserved, and ScoringResponse accepts the result.

Candidate regression for issue scalars, scalar softmax, prompt-token accounting, and unchanged multi-label vectors: 3 passed. Raw output: reports/j-98dfae4a252a/raw/candidate_regression.txt

Independent boundary cases validated issue floats, integer scalars, scalar softmax, pre-shaped single-label rows, and multi-label vectors through ScoringResponse. A raw 0-D tensor injection remains invalid but is outside the actual scheduler transport representation. Raw output: reports/j-98dfae4a252a/raw/candidate_contract_probe.txt

On gfx950, actual CrossEncodingPooler output shape (2,) and issue values matched an independent tensor reference exactly; scheduler-style transport produced Python floats and the candidate validated [[5.875], [-10.109375]] through ScoringResponse. Raw output: reports/j-98dfae4a252a/raw/candidate_gpu_pooler_probe.txt
Adjacent pooler and rerank behavior: 21 passed. Raw output: reports/j-98dfae4a252a/raw/candidate_adjacent_tests.txt

gpu_execution.evidence: One assigned AMD Instinct MI350X, gfx950:sramecc+:xnack-, executed the actual CrossEncodingPooler and exact numerical comparison.

remaining_limitations: BAAI/bge-reranker-v2-m3 weights were unavailable, so the full BGE server and original HTTP curl were not executed.
The deterministic GPU fixture validates the complete reported shape contract, not BGE semantic accuracy.
Validation was on AMD gfx950 with ROCm 7.2 and PyTorch 2.11.0; the reporter's NVIDIA A10/CUDA environment was not available.
No native code changed and the prepared environment declares no separate native component, so no native rebuild was applicable.
